name: [R16] Apache httpd worker crash pattern consistent with mod_http2 double-free (CVE-2026-23918)
message:
Traffic/logs match indicators of CVE-2026-23918, a double-free in Apache HTTP Server's mod_http2 stream-cleanup code (CVSS 8.8, fixed in httpd 2.4.67, released 2026-05-04). Reported trigger: an HTTP/2 HEADERS frame followed quickly by an RST_STREAM with a non-zero error code, pre-auth. Likeliest impact is a worker crash (DoS); RCE is assessed as possible only in some environments.

Standard access logs don't capture HTTP/2 frame types, so this is necessarily indirect: an httpd worker-crash signature near HTTP/2 context, or a Server header still advertising a pre-2.4.67 version. Neither is proof on its own -- confirm against the exact installed httpd version and, if possible, HTTP/2 frame-level (trace) logging.

Tune: if you run httpd with ServerTokens Prod (version suffix stripped from the Server header), the version-based case here will never fire -- rely on the crash-pattern case instead.

queries.name: apache_http2_worker_crash
queries.query: source:apache (@message:*"exit signal Segmentation fault"* OR @message:*"exit signal Aborted"* OR @message:*AH00051*) @message:*http2*

queries.name: apache_pre_2_4_67_server_header
queries.query: source:webserver @http.response.headers.server:(*Apache\/2.4.0* OR *Apache\/2.4.1* OR *Apache\/2.4.2* OR *Apache\/2.4.3* OR *Apache\/2.4.4* OR *Apache\/2.4.5* OR *Apache\/2.4.6*) -@http.response.headers.server:(*Apache\/2.4.67* OR *Apache\/2.4.68* OR *Apache\/2.4.69*)

cases.name: Worker crash near HTTP/2 context observed
Pre-2.4.67 Apache version header observed (leads-generator only)
